verification_open_items: DS18B20 ROM identities read back from the devices, not copied from the configuration table
probe role labels asserted by the capture itself for every frozen slot (t1, t2, t3, t4)
a dated, repository-resolvable physical inspection record naming this configuration - reference validity only, not evidence that anyone reviewed it
EVIDENCE_REVIEWED: a named person must bind this inspection record by recomputed content hash and cover every inspected aspect (currently: empty or placeholder reference)
AUTHORIZED_PROVENANCE: an approval traceable outside the host tooling is required (currently: no approval record was supplied)

must_not_pool: probe-identification touch captures vs any plant capture
captures whose roles disagree with the freeze vs captures that follow it
captures from different installed images (configuration identity differs)

verification_layers.AUTHORIZED_PROVENANCE: an approval of hardware-configuration-verification traced to a record outside the namespace this tool generates
verification_layers.EVIDENCE_REVIEWED: a named person outside the host tooling bound each inspection record by recomputed SHA-256 and enumerated every inspected aspect
verification_layers.REFERENCE_VALID: a dated, repository-resolvable, non-placeholder physical inspection record exists for every capture - the existence of a record, not an act by a person

verification_requirements.installed_image_identity: the installed image identified from this capture's own configuration identity
verification_requirements.physical_inspection_reference_valid: a dated, repository-resolvable physical inspection record naming this configuration - reference validity only, not evidence that anyone reviewed it
verification_requirements.probe_role_labels: probe role labels asserted by the capture itself for every frozen slot (t1, t2, t3, t4)
verification_requirements.role_map_consistent_with_freeze: no captured role token contradicts the operator-frozen slot->role map. This is a consistency test against the frozen map held in source; it is NOT proof that a probe has not physically moved since the freeze
verification_requirements.sensor_rom_readback: DS18B20 ROM identities read back from the devices, not copied from the configuration table

hardware_config_signoff.what_a_matching_hash_does_not_prove: content binding only. It does not show that a physical inspection happened, that a probe has not moved since the freeze, or that a named person approved anything; those need the operator's own authorization provenance, which no host check can manufacture.
hardware_config_signoff.what_the_label_is_not: CG-HW-001 is the intended label for this rig from the W01 as-built record. It is not a verified identity, not a signoff, and not evidence that two captures share a physical configuration - that is what evidence_derived_config_identity and the pooling columns say.
what_would_close_signoff: photograph the installed fuse body and conductor marking (see A-W12-03 items)
read the DS18B20 ROMs back from the devices rather than from the config table
assert probe roles in the capture, or record the mapping as a witnessed inspection
a named person reviews the dated inspection record and binds it by content hash
a named person authorises hardware-configuration-verification through provenance this tooling does not author; a host audit cannot sign it
